text:
carlos-ps: Heads up 10am PT pilot with NimbusPay. They expose a single HTTP/2 tunnel and want to multiplex 100s of logical streams. Need: Python mux snippet, minimal curl fallback, telemetry labels for Datadog, ephemeral creds rotation, and quick hosted vs dedicated cost note for short 2k QPS spikes.

ivy-sales: Demo Wed 2pm PT. Start Hosted, might flip to Dedicated after perf check.

alan-runtime: Python mux sample (tiny):
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='DEMO', enable_mux=True)
s1 = c.stream(model='gpt-4o-mini', stream_id='nimbus-1', trace=True)
for ch in s1: print(ch)
# open another logical stream on same transport
s2 = c.stream(model='gpt-4o-mini', stream_id='nimbus-2')
```
Fallback (curl): curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'

alan-runtime: Telemetry labels: service=nimbus, env=pilot, stream_id, customer_id. Add x-trace-id to correlate with APM.

zoe-devex: For structured output/tool calls show a simple function example so they can validate schema quickly. Recommend a 5-prompt validation set for Optimize.

secbot: Compliance: ask procurement to send SOC2 questionnaire to security@redwood.ai. Quick blockers: dataflow diagram, retention and PII flag, KMS details if Dedicated requested. Turnaround 2-4 business days after we get docs.

ivy-sales: Pricing note?

alan-runtime: For those short 2k QPS bursts we advise either Hosted burst credits (case-by-case) or a small Dedicated slice. Ballpark Dedicated slice for burst handling: $7k-14k/mo depending on GPU. Offer a 10-minute 1k QPS sim during demo to show perf.

carlos-ps: Can someone drop a 1-page runbook + python mux + curl fallback by EOD Mon? I'll pass their procurement contact when I have it.

zoe-devex: I got this 10 will add quick troubleshooting (header stripping, token expiry) and a tiny validator script.
